behaviors.observable_behavior: Invalid calendar representations fail before any create/update mutation; the previous task is preserved.
behaviors.reason: Approved real-calendar validation; unit invalid-write regression asserts last saved title/date and task count remain unchanged.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Only unfinished dated tasks strictly before the device-local day are Overdue; today, future and undated tasks are not.
behaviors.reason: Approved overdue predicate, not an input rejection. Unit tests distinguish past/today/future/undated/completed.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Create omission defaults to no date; PATCH omission leaves the previously saved date unchanged.
behaviors.reason: Approved optional/additive field. Store regression covers omission and completion-only PATCH retention.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Non-calendar wire representations (including timestamps and wrong types) are rejected; no past-date or year-window rejection is imposed.
behaviors.reason: Approved date-only representation and real-calendar validation. Positive years of at least four digits are checked by arithmetic, including beyond four digits.

behaviors.observable_behavior: An empty native badInput draft is invalid and cannot be treated as an intentional clear.
behaviors.reason: The draft helper and editor validity gate preserve the saved value; helper unit regression exercises the native validity contract. Actual browser entry remains QA work.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Manual canonical text entry supplements the native calendar picker; opening an unrepresentable saved native value falls back to text without clearing it.
behaviors.reason: Avoids introducing a platform year-range business restriction. Browser-specific interactions still require actual QA execution.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Completed tasks retain due dates without overdue emphasis; reopening restores the indication if applicable.
behaviors.reason: Completion changes no saved date. Store and predicate unit tests cover retention, reopening and warning predicate.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Today is derived from local calendar components; saved date strings never become UTC timestamps.
behaviors.reason: Opposite-timezone subprocess unit checks and calendar comparisons exercise date-only semantics.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Cancel cancels only pending draft work and closes the editor; previous autosaves are not rolled back.
behaviors.reason: Preserves existing cancellation contract. New date drafts join the same autosave/dirty state; real browser cancellation checks remain pending QA.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Migration rechecks schema under a transaction; only the supported v1-to-v2 additive change runs, and failures roll back without replacing legacy tasks.
behaviors.reason: Approved persistence/compatibility design. Store unit tests exercise migration, idempotency, rollback and reopen; existing unsupported-schema negative regression remains.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Date assignment, overdue state and completion do not reorder creation order.
behaviors.reason: Existing sequence ordering remains unchanged; legacy migration and unit CRUD ordering regressions retain it.

behaviors.observable_behavior: Local day/visibility refresh updates only date labels, preserving task-control focus and open editor drafts.
behaviors.reason: Date presentation update does not rebuild list buttons; this is author source review, with real keyboard/browser verification still pending.

conformance.summary: Source-bound author review against approved FR/AC authority; no unsupported restriction found. Unit/build executed; actual browser/HTTP QA and independent human code review remain pending.
